behavior: Calling java_hover, java_definition or java_references against a ready, routable workspace with a line/column beyond the file's current content (e.g. past the last line or last column) always produces a structured error naming the invalid-position case, distinguishable from any error JDT LS itself would raise; it is rejected before an LSP call is made, never passed through and never a successful result.
rationale: 'Rejected before any LSP call' is only observable via response shape: validating first always yields the tool layer's own invalid-position error, while letting the coordinate reach JDT LS yields whatever raw, non-taxonomy error that method returns -- never the tool layer's own case. Real workspace/fixture per integration/e2e_scenario and this feature's falsifier [INV-TOOL-5]. Falsifies an oversized coordinate reaching the real LSP call instead of being rejected first.
